entities.name: PMID:25422754
observations: Khazaei et al. studied lactating rats on postpartum day 8 and measured arcuate KiSS-1 mRNA by real-time PCR after litter-size and suckling manipulations.
Litters were adjusted to 5, 10, or 15 pups; separate 5-pup dams underwent 6-hour pup separation followed by 2.5, 5, or 7.5 minutes of suckling.
The retrieved evidence does not establish the rat strain.

entities.name: ARC KiSS-1 suppression
observations: With continuous suckling, dams with 5 pups had higher arcuate KiSS-1 mRNA than dams with 10 or 15 pups (P<0.0001), indicating suppression with increased litter size.

After 6-hour separation of 5-pup litters, 2.5 minutes of suckling produced higher arcuate KiSS-1 mRNA than 5 or 7.5 minutes (P<0.0001), indicating stronger suppression with increased suckling intensity.
The authors reported that the suckling-intensity effect was more pronounced than the litter-size effect.
